metadata.title: NEXTPATH Learning Resource Catalog
metadata.resource_model: skills -> topics + free resources + practice + paid resources + project
notes: Estimated learning hours are planning estimates, not guarantees.
External course availability, pricing, URLs, and curricula can change.
NEXTPATH should verify external links periodically before presenting them as active.
The roadmap should prioritize the largest demonstrated skill gaps first.

SQL.description: Learn relational databases, querying, joins, aggregation, subqueries, CTEs, window functions, data cleaning, and performance-aware SQL.

topics.title: INNER, LEFT, RIGHT and FULL joins

project.title: Business Sales Analytics Database
project.description: Create and analyze a sales database with customers, products, orders, revenue trends, repeat customers, and executive KPIs.

Python.description: Build a strong Python foundation for data analysis, automation, AI, backend services, and problem solving.

topics.title: Syntax, variables, data types and operators
Testing, clean code and project structure

project.title: Python Data Automation Toolkit
project.description: Build a Python application that imports CSV files, cleans data, calculates metrics, and exports reports.

Excel.description: Develop practical spreadsheet skills for analysis, reporting, cleaning, modeling, and business decision support.

topics.title: IF, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS and logical formulas

project.title: Executive Sales Dashboard in Excel
project.description: Build an interactive Excel dashboard using cleaned transactional data, pivots, formulas, KPIs, and charts.

Power BI.description: Learn Power BI data modeling, Power Query, DAX, visualization, dashboard design, and publishing workflows.

topics.title: Power BI Desktop and data import

project.title: Business Performance Intelligence Dashboard
project.description: Create a multi-page Power BI dashboard covering revenue, customer performance, products, regions, trends, and executive KPIs.

Statistics.description: Learn descriptive statistics, probability, distributions, inference, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, correlation, and regression foundations.

project.title: Statistical Study of Student Performance
project.description: Analyze a dataset using descriptive statistics, distributions, confidence intervals, hypothesis tests, correlation, and regression.

Machine Learning.description: Learn supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation, feature engineering, tuning, pipelines, and responsible model development.

topics.title: Machine learning workflow and problem framing

project.title: Customer Churn Prediction System
project.description: Train, compare, evaluate, and explain multiple classification models for customer churn.

Deep Learning.description: Learn neural networks, optimization, CNNs, sequence models, transformers, and practical deep-learning workflows.

project.title: Image Classification Application
project.description: Train and evaluate a CNN-based image classifier and expose predictions through a simple application.

Data Visualization.description: Learn visual encoding, chart selection, storytelling, dashboard design, and clear communication of analytical insights.

project.title: Executive Data Story
project.description: Turn a raw dataset into a concise visual story with KPIs, trends, key findings, and recommendations.

Business Analysis.description: Learn problem framing, stakeholder analysis, business requirements, KPI design, process improvement, and decision support.

project.title: Digital Service Improvement Case
project.description: Analyze an existing process, identify stakeholders and pain points, define requirements, KPIs, and recommend an improved solution.

Communication.description: Improve professional writing, presentations, stakeholder communication, analytical storytelling, interviews, and collaboration.

project.title: Five-Minute Career Presentation
project.description: Create and deliver a concise presentation explaining a technical project to a non-technical audience.

Data Warehousing.description: Learn dimensional modeling, fact and dimension tables, star schemas, warehouse architecture, ELT patterns, and analytical data design.

project.title: Retail Analytics Warehouse
project.description: Design a dimensional model for retail sales with facts, dimensions, business grain, and analytical queries.

ETL.description: Learn extraction, transformation, loading, validation, scheduling, incremental processing, and reliable data-pipeline design.

project.title: Automated ETL Pipeline
project.description: Create a scheduled pipeline that loads raw CSV/API data, cleans and validates it, and writes analytics-ready output.

Cloud Computing.description: Learn cloud fundamentals, compute, storage, networking, databases, identity, deployment, monitoring, and cost-awareness.

project.title: Cloud-Deployed Data Application
project.description: Deploy a small data or AI application with cloud storage, environment configuration, monitoring, and documentation.

Apache Spark.description: Learn distributed data processing, Spark DataFrames, transformations, actions, Spark SQL, partitioning, and performance concepts.

project.title: Large-Scale Log Analytics
project.description: Use Spark to process and aggregate a large event/log dataset and generate analytical outputs.

Data Modeling.description: Learn conceptual, logical, physical, relational, dimensional, and analytical data modeling.

project.title: University Information Data Model
project.description: Design a complete relational and analytical model for students, courses, attendance, assessments, and performance.

Git.description: Learn version control, commits, branches, merging, collaboration, pull requests, conflict resolution, and practical GitHub workflows.

topics.title: Tags, release basics and useful workflows

project.title: Professional GitHub Project Repository
project.description: Create a structured repository with branches, issues, pull requests, documentation, releases, and a clean commit history.

DAX.description: Learn DAX measures, filter context, row context, CALCULATE, iterators, time intelligence, and analytical modeling in Power BI.

project.title: Advanced DAX KPI Dashboard
project.description: Build a Power BI model with business measures, time intelligence, variance metrics, and dynamic KPI calculations.

MLOps.description: Learn reproducible ML pipelines, model tracking, deployment, monitoring, CI/CD, containers, registries, and production reliability.

project.title: Production ML Pipeline
project.description: Train, track, package, containerize, deploy, and monitor a machine-learning model.

Docker.description: Learn images, containers, Dockerfiles, volumes, networks, Compose, registries, and application packaging.

project.title: Containerized FastAPI Application
project.description: Package a FastAPI service and its dependencies into a reusable Docker image.

Generative AI.description: Learn LLM foundations, prompting, embeddings, retrieval, RAG, structured output, agents, evaluation, safety, and production integration.

topics.title: Structured outputs and tool calling concepts

project.title: RAG Career Assistant
project.description: Build a retrieval-augmented assistant that answers questions from a controlled career knowledge base.

NLP.description: Learn text preprocessing, vectorization, embeddings, classification, sequence modeling, transformers, and NLP evaluation.

project.title: Support Ticket Classifier
project.description: Build a text-classification system that routes support tickets into predefined categories.

API Development.description: Learn REST principles, HTTP, FastAPI, validation, authentication concepts, testing, documentation, and deployment-ready APIs.

project.title: Career Recommendation REST API
project.description: Build a documented FastAPI backend with CRUD endpoints, validation, authentication-ready structure, and tests.

A/B Testing.description: Learn experimental design, hypotheses, metrics, significance, power, sample size, pitfalls, and product experimentation.

project.title: Product Experiment Analysis
project.description: Analyze a simulated A/B experiment, define success metrics, test hypotheses, and recommend whether to launch the change.

Product Analytics.description: Learn funnels, cohorts, retention, activation, engagement, product metrics, event data, and product decision-making.

project.title: User Funnel and Retention Analysis
project.description: Analyze user events to measure acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, and churn.

Marketing Analytics.description: Learn campaign measurement, customer segmentation, acquisition metrics, conversion, ROI, attribution concepts, and marketing dashboards.

project.title: Multi-Channel Campaign Performance Analysis
project.description: Compare marketing channels using conversion, CAC, revenue, ROI, and customer-segment performance.

Google Analytics.description: Learn digital analytics concepts, events, conversions, traffic acquisition, user behavior, reports, and measurement planning.

project.title: Website Measurement Plan
project.description: Create a digital measurement plan with business objectives, events, conversions, traffic KPIs, and dashboard requirements.

Requirements Engineering.description: Learn requirements elicitation, analysis, documentation, acceptance criteria, prioritization, traceability, and change management.

project.title: Career Platform Requirements Specification
project.description: Create a structured requirements document for a career-guidance platform with users, workflows, acceptance criteria, and non-functional requirements.

Process Modeling.description: Learn process discovery, flowcharts, BPMN concepts, current-state and future-state analysis, bottlenecks, and process improvement.

project.title: University Registration Process Redesign
project.description: Model the current registration process, identify bottlenecks, and design an improved future-state workflow.

Problem Solving.description: Develop structured problem decomposition, root-cause analysis, prioritization, estimation, decision-making, and analytical reasoning.

project.title: Structured Business Problem Case
project.description: Solve a realistic ambiguous business problem using decomposition, hypotheses, data, prioritization, and recommendation.

Data Governance.description: Learn data ownership, quality, lineage, metadata, security, privacy, stewardship, policies, and governance operating models.

project.title: Student Data Governance Framework
project.description: Design a governance framework for academic and career data covering owners, quality rules, access, privacy, lineage, and retention.

System Design.description: Learn scalable architecture, APIs, databases, caching, queues, reliability, security, trade-offs, and distributed-system design.

project.title: NEXTPATH System Architecture
project.description: Design a scalable architecture for NEXTPATH covering authentication, profiles, assessments, roadmap, certificates, storage, APIs, and deployment.

Leadership.description: Develop mentoring, delegation, feedback, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, decision-making, and team leadership skills.

project.title: Team Leadership Plan
project.description: Create a leadership plan for a small analytics or AI project team covering goals, roles, feedback, milestones, and risks.
